desc: Base life (GARDEN.md section 4, scripts/home/base_life.gd): with farm_build.json base_mode on, every farm Boki runs one state machine (Roam, Eat, Nap, Play, PlayWith, Watch, React, Mentor, Chore) and keeps rec['bonds'] = {uid: -1..1}. Times are seconds, distances metres (tiles), bond changes are per event unless they say per second.
think_doc: s between a roaming Boki's choices (random in the range).
max_doc: s a Boki stays in each state before it moves on (Play is HomeToys' time at a toy, toys.json play_secs; eat also caps the walk for a snack, BaseFeed); a Boki that roamed this long picks something to do. Nap has no cap: night naps last till morning.
chore_chance_doc: chance a roaming Boki whose knack has a chore to do right now (scripts/home/base_chore.gd) does it.
chore_mind_doc: s an Ember Boki sits by the egg before the egg's hatch time halves.
nap_doc: s of a day nap (energy low or bored); at night a non-nocturnal Boki naps till dawn.
tired_at_doc: energy need below which a Boki naps by day.
near_doc: m within which another Boki counts as close: a play mate, a rival to stare at, a pile to join.
pile_doc: how close two napping friends may lie, as a share of their normal personal space.
parent_weight_doc: added to a young (not yet Grown) Boki's liking for its own parent when it picks who to greet or nap beside; a weight, so a parent it has fallen out with (bond -0.5 or less) still loses.
bond_doc: a bond at or above friend_at is a friendship, at or below rival_at a rivalry.
bond_tag_doc: added to both Boki's bond each time one tags the other in a game of tag.
bond_share_doc: added when two Boki that get on share a toy.
bond_nap_doc: per second two Boki nap side by side.
bond_squabble_doc: added when two Boki squabble over a toy or their tempers clash.
mentor_doc: s between a retired mentor's slow steps near the Soul Shrine (Mentor, GARDEN.md section 3).
mentor_radius_doc: m from the Soul Shrine a mentor strolls.
clash_doc: the summed temper above 1.0 at which two Boki that meet may squabble; higher tempers squabble more.
shy_doc: a Boki adopted from the Shelter is shy for secs of farm time (one farm day, home.gd DAY_LEN; scripts/home/base_shy.gd): it keeps to the island's edge (the farthest from the middle of edge_picks open spots) and takes no part in tag or toys.
whistle_doc: the whistle (scripts/home/base_whistle.gd): hold_s s the key is held before the nearest other Boki is called as well as your partner; a Boki with joy need under sulky_joy or trust under shy_trust only looks over (a droop and a head turn), waits wait_s s and walks over at sulky_pace of the call run; an answering Boki first makes a beat: perk_s s, plus up to turn_s s to turn to face you (so one already facing you loses only perk_s); slot_m m from you where an answering Boki stops; pace is the run speed scale at no eagerness and at full eagerness (trust 60%, condition 40%), on the farm's 4.4 m/s call run; give_up_s s before an answer that has not arrived is dropped; the hint_* keys are the one-time whistle line (scripts/home/whistle_hint.gd): shown once the partner has been over hint_far_m m away, or out of sight, for hint_away_s s; hint_lift_px px above the screen's bottom edge (over the key row); hint_text beside the key cap.
